results.releaseNotes:
AI tab redesign: your latest tokens/sec now sits right next to the neural pulse, and while a benchmark runs the screen stays focused on the live answer and system monitor.

New 1024-token endurance length, plus an "Epic story" prompt built to fill long runs. The default length is now 256 tokens. The 64-token option was retired: runs that short measured startup noise, not real speed.

Battery section in Device Info: charge level, power source, and Low Power Mode at a glance.

Low Power Mode protection: the app now warns you before benchmarking with Low Power Mode on, and those runs stay on your device so throttled scores never skew the community leaderboards.

iPhone 17e is now recognized by name.

Small fixes and polish.
results.description:
PulzeMark measures how fast your iPhone and iPad really are: CPU, storage, and on-device AI, all in one app. Every result is scored and compared against a live, anonymous, crowdsourced leaderboard, so you can see exactly where your device stands.

ON-DEVICE AI BENCHMARK
Download a free, open-source language model and run it entirely on your device. PulzeMark measures how many tokens per second your iPhone or iPad generates, plus prompt throughput and time to first token. No cloud, no account. Compare your device against others running the same model at the same output length.

CPU AND REAL-WORLD TESTS
Single-core and multi-core CPU, plus real workloads: integer and floating point math, cryptography, compression, photo processing, and UI layout. You get a clear score and a live timeline of CPU usage and thermal state during the run.

STORAGE SPEED
Sequential and random read and write, with configurable file size, block size, and passes. See your real disk throughput in MB/s.

COMPARE EVERYTHING
Results are crowdsourced anonymously. Compare your device against the fastest iPhone or iPad, per category and per AI model, and browse the full leaderboard on the web.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-in, no tracking, no personal data. Submissions are anonymous: just the device model, scores, and raw metrics.

FEATURES
- CPU single-core and multi-core benchmarks
- Real-world tests: photo processing and UI layout
- Storage read and write, sequential and random
- On-device LLM benchmark in tokens per second
- Live CPU and thermal monitoring during runs
- Crowdsourced, anonymous leaderboards
- Per-model AI comparison across devices
- Shareable result cards
- Works on iPhone and iPad

Benchmark your device, then see how it stacks up against the world.
